scope: Independent complete UI, template, builder and guide source review; embedded deck byte comparison only, no model suite, build command, browser or visual execution.
findings: Live state changes only through makeBloomState on insertion, reset and A+B restoration; every render derives query, exact membership and fixed experiment from that state.
Repeated insertion preserves distinct exact members and bits while announcing the operation. Removal dropdown is rebuilt from actual members, with retained selection only when valid.
Deletion preview is read-only against live state; empty state disables picker and hides obsolete preview. Restoring A+B restores X query and A preview.
Random two-bit experiment is rendered once from separate enumeration; template and guide explicitly distinguish seven fixed keys from independent uniform query positions.

Builder validates original deck with maintained parser, resolves source from module URL, enforces unique markers and import boundary, escapes embedded lesson literal and uses exclusive temporary output; check mode compares without writing.

Native controls, aria labels/status, visible exact set and preview labels are explicit. Actual browser, download activation, responsive layout and focus receiving remain author/native responsibilities.
